Name: Daily Tasks Report Plus
Author: klatuprism
Description:
[size=3]An updated/enhanced version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1624]Daily Task Report[/url] by GuiNoya [/size]

[b][u][size=4]Added:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]SDV 1.6 compatibility[/size]
[*][size=3]Re-wrote the code to search all locations and not just the Farm for Crops, Animals and Machines[/size]
[*][size=3]Added checking ponds for wanted items or items to collect[/size]
[*][size=3]Added warning for end-of-the-month crop harvesting[/size]
[/list]
[b][u][size=4]Changes:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]The default open report key is now 'P'. (The 'Y' key hides the emote icons)[/size]
[*][size=3]The default bubble toggle key is now '*'[/size]
[*][size=3]The default open settings menu is now '-'[/size]
[/list]
[b][u][size=4]Settings[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]The mod settings are done by a mod provided menu.  The default  key to open the settings is '-'.  I am looking at how to revamp the settings menus to accommodate dynamic Crops and Machines.[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][size=3]Press P to open your report or click the button below the quests button. It shows (with detailed information about each item):
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If The Queen of Sauce has a new recipe for you[/size]
[*][size=3]If it's someone's birthday[/size]
[*][size=3]If the Travelling merchant is in town[/size]
[*][size=3]Unwatered crops (Anywhere)[/size]
[*][size=3]Crops ready to harvest (Anywhere)[/size]
[*][size=3]Dead crops[/size]
[*][size=3]If you did not pet your pet[/size]
[*][size=3]If you did not fill your pet's bowl[/size]
[*][size=3]Animals that were not petted[/size]
[*][size=3]Animals products ready to collect[/size]
[*][size=3]Empty hay spots on feedings benches[/size]
[*][size=3]If there are fruits/mushrooms to be collected in your farm cave.[/size]
[*][size=3]Crab pots ready to be collected[/size]
[*][size=3]Crab pots that were not baited[/size]
[*][size=3]Machines ready to collect (full list of machines in the configuration section)[/size]
[*][size=3]Ponds that have items to collect[/size]
[*][size=3]Ponds that have requests[/size]
[*][size=3]End of the month warning to harvest flowers and crops[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]The mod can draw bubbles for (there is a configurable keybinding to turn them on/off without entering any menu):
[list]
[*]Unwatered crops
[*]Crops ready to harvest
[*]Dead crops
[*]Pet wants to be petted
[*]Animals that were not petted
[*]Animals that have produce
[*]If there is animal produce inside a building
[*]If there are hay spots missing in the animal house
[*]Truffles
[*]Crab pots that were not baited
[*]Casks with a minimum item quality (set in the configuration)
[/list][/size]
[b][size=4][u]Included Languages[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]English
[*]German - Deutsch (Thanks Th3Tob1)
[/list][b][size=4][u]Optional Downloadable Languages[/u][/size][/b][list]
[*]Russian (Thanks Twwe)
[/list]
[b][u][size=4]Future Releases[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]Currently the animal product types and the machine types are hard coded into the mod and only check for items that are part of the non-modded game.  Future releases will add the ability to check for any machine and any type of animal product based upon the mods installed.

Source Code: [url=https://github.com/Prism-99/DailyTaskReportPlus]Github[/url][/size]
